title: Leadership | National Center for Chronic Disease Prevention and Health Promotion (NCCDPHP) | CDC
content: Leadership Dec. 9, 2025 At a glance CDC's National Center for Chronic Disease Prevention and Health Promotion (NCCDPHP) leads and coordinates the work of nine divisions that work to reduce health behaviors that lead to chronic conditions. Read the professional biographies of our center and division leaders. Center and division leadership Center leadership CAPT Djenaba Joseph, MD, MPH, Acting Director Dr. Gregory Crawford, Deputy Director for Management, Operations, Communications, and Policy Mattie Gilliam, Management Officer Sean Cucchi, Associate Director for Policy Gabbi Promoff, Associate Director for Communication Science Dr. Romeo Galang, Medical Director Dr. Rachel Kaufmann, Associate Director for Science Dr. Timothy Carney, Associate Director for Informatics Dr. Leonard Jack, Jr, Editor-in-Chief, Preventing Chronic Disease Dr. Raegan Tuff, Senior Advisor for Health Impact Dr. Charlan Kroelinger, Maternal and Infant Health Branch Chief Dr. Machell Town, Population Health Surveillance Branch Chief Division leadership Dr. Mike Underwood, Acting Director of the Division of Adolescent and School Health CAPT Jacqueline Miller, MD, FACS, Acting Director of the Division of Cancer Prevention and Control Dr. Christopher Holliday, Director of the Division of Diabetes Translation Dr. Letitia Presley-Cantrell, Acting Director of the Division for Heart Disease and Stroke Prevention Dr. Janelle Gunn, Acting Director of the Division of Nutrition, Physical Activity, and Obesity Dec. 9, 2025 Sources Print Share Facebook LinkedIn Twitter Syndicate Content Source: National Center for Chronic Disease Prevention and Health Promotion (NCCDPHP)
